steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each controlled document is placed by its version, its approval and its review date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Obsolete version in use
findings.fix: Withdraw the old version and reissue

findings.title: Approval dated after the effective date

outcome.notChecked: Whether staff use the current version; documents outside the register.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] sop-inspection-v2.md:12  Obsolete version in use.
       Fix: Withdraw the old version and reissue.
[medium] manual-quality-v5.md:19  Approval dated after the effective date.
       Fix: Correct the approval record.
[low] work-inst-v4.md:26  Document with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether staff use the current version; documents outside the register.
pros: Checks a review date passed, a version that is not the latest in the register, an approval missing or dated after the effective date, and a document with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether staff use the current version; documents outside the register.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-document-control skill on the records for this review.
